error[ZBX-E1017]: a published port cannot be listened on on the Mac
  cause  port 8080 is already in use on this Mac, by another program
  fix    see what holds it:   lsof -nP -iTCP:8080 -sTCP:LISTEN
         or publish a port from 1024 up: --publish <port>:<container port>
  more   zbx explain E1017 · rerun with --verbose for the full cause chain
  docs   https://zigbox.github.io/zigbox/errors/E1017.html
